name: substack-gateway-worker
description: Unofficial Cloudflare Worker port of substack-gateway-oss. Not affiliated with Substack.

GATEWAY_API_KEYS.description: Optional. Turns on owner mode. A comma list of `label:key` entries (or `label:sha256:<hex>` to store only a hash). Callers must then send `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Generate a key with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Leave blank for open pass-through mode, where every caller supplies their own Substack cookies.

OWNER_PUBLICATION_URL.description: Owner mode only. Your publication URL, for example `https://yourname.substack.com`. Set together with the two cookies below, or leave all three blank.

OWNER_SUBSTACK_SID.description: Owner mode only. The value of your `substack.sid` cookie. This is a full-account credential and Substack's Terms may restrict automated use; see the README. Leave blank for pass-through mode.

OWNER_CONNECT_SID.description: Owner mode only. The value of your `connect.sid` cookie. A full-account credential; see the README. Leave blank for pass-through mode.

OWNER_ALLOWED_FEATURES.description: Optional. Feature names allowed with your owner cookies. Prefix each entry with `+` to add it to the default (for example `+api:notes:create,+mcp:notes:create`); a list without `+` replaces the default. Do not mix the two forms. Leave blank for the default: reads, draft create/update, pre-publish checks and image upload only. Nothing publishes unless you add it.
